component.name: Retrosaver
component.summary: Classic XScreenSaver modules for GNOME on Wayland

description.p: Retrosaver brings back the late-1990s XScreenSaver display modules, such as the atlantis fish tank, flame fractals, flying toasters and spinning pipes, on GNOME desktops running Wayland, where the traditional screensaver daemon no longer works.

This app sets how long the computer waits before the screensaver starts, how often it switches modules, and when the screen locks and turns off. It also picks which modules can appear and turns the screensaver on or off.
Retrosaver is not a screen locker. Locking is handed to GNOME's own lock screen.
